title: Lunar Diplomacy
start: Go to the westernmost dock of Rellekka and talk to Lokar Searunner.

items.t: Coins (1,000 should be enough, there is a bank on the island)
Runes for combat spells (preferably fire spells, elemental staff not equippable)
Air, earth, fire, and water talismans, or alternate methods of accessing the respective runecrafting altars (e.g. a wicked hood consumed the aforementioned talisman)
Two spools of thread (can be obtained during the quest - Crafting cape perk works as well)
Clean guam (may be obtained from dropped grimy guam during the quest, common drop)
Clean marrentill (may be obtained from dropped grimy marrentill during the quest, common drop)

recommended.t: Extra dramen staves (if interested in making more lunar staves)

rewards.t: Ability to buy astral runes from Baba Yaga
A set of Lunar equipment (obtained during quest)
Ability to have suqahs assigned as a Slayer task
Ability to unlock the Ourania Teleport spell from the Lunar Spellbook, by talking to Baba Yaga with Lunar spells active
An extra 10338 Magic XP when Swept Away quest is completed and the broomstick is brought to Baba Yaga (with level 73 Magic)
The ability to Home Teleport to the Lunar Isle lodestone
The seal of passage can now be used to teleport to Lunar Isle once per day

steps.t: Choose the 'talk to' option on Lokar Searunner on Rellekka's westernmost dock. [Chat: 2 You've been away from these parts for a while? › 1 Why did you leave? › Accept]
Speak to Brundt the Chieftain in the Longhall for a seal of passage.  [Chat: 1 Ask about a seal of passage.]

sub.t: You will need to keep the seal on you while on the island. Talking to anyone without it will teleport you back to Rellekka.

steps.t: Return and talk to Lokar. [Chat: 1 Arrr! Yar! Let's be on our way, yar!]
Climb the ladder and board the pirate ship. Talk to Captain Bentley about sailing to Lunar Isle. [Chat: 4 Can we sail to Lunar Isle now?]

sub.t: Make sure to be sufficiently on the pirate ship, otherwise the quest will not progress.

steps.t: Climb down the central ladder.
Below deck, talk to 'Bird's-Eye' Jack to the south-west.
Talk to Captain Bentley again. [Chat: 2 Perhaps it's the Navigator's fault?]
Return to 'Birds-Eye' Jack again.
Must talk to them in this order.

sub.t: Talk to 'Eagle-eye' Shultz at the very front of the ship (back upstairs).
Talk to 'Beefy' Burns on the lowest level of the ship.
Talk to 'Lecherous' Lee on the very top level, at the south end of the ship.
Talk to First mate 'Davey-boy' on the southern end of the deck near the stairs.
Climb up to the top level at the south end of the ship and talk to the cabin boy (2 inventory spaces required). He is next to Lecherous Lee.

steps.t: Use the lens on the lantern. Light it.
Use the lantern on the following objects and rub away the symbols:

sub.t: Barrel: Return to the lowest level of the ship. It is the southernmost stack of three barrels. [Chat: 1 Rub away!]
Support: On the same level, it is the big support column in the middle of the ship. [Chat: 1 Rub away!]
Chest: Same level still, before going back up, it is the chest on the ground just northwest of the ladder. [Chat: 1 Rub away!]
Cannon: Climb the ladder up one level. It is the long cannon at the very south end of the ship, directly behind 'Bird's-Eye' Jack. [Chat: 1 Rub away!]
Wallchart: Finally, climb up to the main deck and enter the southernmost room. It is the wallchart on the northwestern wall. [Chat: 1 Rub away!]

p: Cannon with jinx symbol, on lower deck, beside 'Bird's-Eye' Jack
Wallchart with jinx symbol on main deck, north from First mate 'Davey-boy'
Chest with jinx symbol, on lowest deck, next to 'Betty' B.Boppin and in front of the toilets
Support with jinx symbol, on lowest deck, in front of captured suqah
Southernmost stacked barrels (left hand side in the picture) with jinx symbol, on lowest deck, beside 'Beefy' Burns and the galley

steps.t: Talk to Captain Bentley.
Climb down the ladders and walk into the city (there will be a small cutscene).
Go north-east outside the city and kill suqah until these items are obtained:

sub.t: One suqah tooth.
4 suqah hides.
If not already in the backpack, one grimy guam and one grimy marrentill. Clean the herbs.

steps.t: Mine a lunar ore at the mine north-east of the city. Climb down the ladder and mine a stalagmite to the West of the rune essence rock. It looks like a rock jutting out of the ground.

sub.t: Optional: Mine Rune Essence to complete Runes on the Moon, which is a Hard Fremennik achievement.

steps.t: Run to the south-east part of the island. Talk to the Oneiromancer near the astral altar.
Return to the city and enter the walking house in the northern section. Talk to Baba Yaga (1 inventory space required). [Chat: 2 The Oneiromancer told me you may be able to help...]
Use the vial on the sink.

sub.t: Add a guam and a marrentill to the vial of water.
Grind the suqah tooth and use it on the vial to complete the potion.

p: A safespot that can be used while killing suqahs

steps.t: Return to the Oneiromancer with the potion.
Use your dramen staff/staves on the following altars in the listed order (you may need talismans to access if you do not have alternate teleports):

sub.t: Air (west of Varrock)
Fire (north of Al Kharid)
Water (Lumbridge Swamp)
Earth (south of Fort Forinthry)

p: Enchanting the staff at the earth altar

steps.t: Before returning to the isle, smelt the lunar ore at any regular furnace and make a lunar helmet at a regular anvil.
Travel back to Lunar Isle by selecting "travel" from Lokar Searunner in Rellekka at the westernmost dock.
Travel with Captain Bentley to Lunar Isle.
Give a lunar staff to the Oneiromancer.
If you have already made the lunar helm, you can skip the next 4 steps.

sub.t: Climb down ladder north-eastern part of the isle.
Mine a stalagmite for a lunar ore.
You have to use a furnace to smith the ore (the forge in the southern building will not work).
Use an anvil to make the helm, such as the one in the southern building.

p: Mining a stalagmite to obtain lunar ore

steps.t: Talk to Pauline Polaris in the north-western-most building in the city. [Chat: 2 Pauline.] Choose the correct answer "Jane Blud-Hagic-Maid". The answers are randomly ordered.
Talk to Meteora south in the city.
Kill Suqahs until one drops a special tiara. If you haven't already, pick up their hide as well as you'll need four hides later on.
Give Meteora the tiara.
Talk to Rimae Sirsalis in the clothing store south of the bank about ceremonial clothes. [Chat: 2 You know the ceremonial clothes?]
Talk to Rimae Sirsalis again, she will tan your hides. [Chat: 2 You know the ceremonial clothes? › 1 That seems like a fair deal.]

sub.t: If you didn't bring thread, Rimae's shop sells some.

steps.t: Craft a lunar torso, trousers, gloves, and boots from your hides.
Go to the biggest building in the city (west of the lodestone) and talk to Selene (she might be outside). [Chat: 2 I'm looking for a ring.]
Exit the city and run south. Dig up near blue flowers with a spade (tool belt doesn't work), they are the flowers to the furthest south west across the bridge. Make sure to finish the dialogue.
Give the Oneiromancer all your lunar gear.
Talk to the Oneiromancer again with 11 free inventory slots.
Use the vial on the kindling Oneiromancer just gave you to create soaked kindling.
Get your combat runes and supplies, dismiss your follower, and wear all your lunar items. Four backpack spaces are required.
Do not carry an augmented crystal hatchet in the backpack to avoid a bug later in the quest.
Run to the biggest building in the city (west of the lodestone).

Make sure you're wearing all 8 pieces of Lunar equipment; if you exit to lobby or logout, or are not wearing them all when you add the soaked kindling, you'll have to return to the Oneiromancer to get a new kindling.
Light the ceremonial brazier then use the Soaked kindling on it to enter Dreamland.
Talk to Ethereal Man or Ethereal Lady.
Step on the yellow/green platform south-west of the island.
Talk to Ethereal Fluke.

He will call out a number. You need to make the dice add up to the number he called. When you "roll" one of the dice, it will turn the die upside down, so each die only has two possible numbers (1 and 6, 2 and 5, 3 and 4).
p: Rolling the dice with the Ethereal Fluke

steps.t: He eventually teleports you back to the middle.
Talk to the Ethereal Man/Lady.
Head south-east and step on the pink/purple platform.
Talk to Ethereal Numerator.
Click on the numbers to complete the patterns for four times.
p: Looking for patterns with the Ethereal Numerator. Maths teachers don't wear lunar equipment in real life.

steps.t: He eventually teleports you back to the middle.
Talk to the Ethereal Man/Lady.
Head north-east and step on the blue platform.

Talk to Ethereal Perceptive. He might give you a hatchet. [Chat: 1 Ok, let's go!] (Do not carry an augmented crystal hatchet in the backpack or you will be given the following message: "You do not have a hatchet which you have the Woodcutting level to use" even if you have another hatchet in the backpack or a hatchet on your toolbelt)
Run west and chop 20 dream logs, depositing them on your log pile.
p: Chopping dream trees with the Ethereal Perceptive.

steps.t: He will teleport you once you've won the competition.
Talk to the Ethereal Man/Lady.
Head north-west and step on the grey platform.
p: Hopping from one dream puff to another. Dreamy.

steps.t: Talk to Ethereal Guide.

Cross the chasm by jumping on the correct combination of Dream Puffs. Keep a note of the correct steps! You can use the table below to track your path: click cell to highlight it. Click again to cancel a highlight.
Once complete, talk to the Ethereal Man/Lady.
Head east and step on the yellow platform.
Talk to Ethereal Expert and start the race. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
p: The Ethereal Expert, standing confidently at the start of his route

steps.t: Jump over the hurdles. If you fail three times, you will lose the race. Run and stop before each hurdle, before clicking the orb to jump over.
p: Jumping over a hurdle, the expert in the rear
A player jumps a hurdle in order to beat the Ethereal Expert

steps.t: After you have won talk to the Ethereal Man/Lady.
Head south-east and step on the green platform.
Talk to Ethereal Mimic. [Chat: 1 Suppose I may as well have a go.]
Click on them and then copy the emote that they perform. They teleport after each correct emote.
p: Ready to be a mime, with the Ethereal Mimic in the background

steps.t: After five correct emotes, they'll teleport you back.
Talk to the Ethereal Man/Lady to begin the final fight. [Chat: 1 Of course. I'm ready.]
Kill Me (6,000 life points, weakness to fire spells). You can safe-spot them behind the dream tree.

sub.t: Should you forget your runes after entering the fight, you will not be able to leave the fight in any way unless you log out and back in. This will take you back to Lunar Isle where you can bank to get the runes.
Be sure to equip your Seal of passage before speaking to a banker.
Go back to the Oneiromancer again to get the kindling and potion to return back to the dream.
Re-equip your Lunar amulet before attempting to enter the dream.

steps.t: Read the lectern to return to Lunar Isle. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to the Oneiromancer.
Quest complete!
